import gc,json,sys,unittest
errors=[]
sys.unraisablehook=lambda e:errors.append(type(e.exc_value).__name__)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tools/eo-validation',pattern='test_run_checks.py')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
gc.collect()
summary={'tests_run':result.testsRun,'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'skips':len(result.skipped),'unraisable_errors':errors}
summary['status']='PASSED' if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun==12 and not result.skipped and not errors else 'FAILED'
print(json.dumps(summary))
raise SystemExit(0 if summary['status']=='PASSED' else 1)
